item.title: Mr Eazi & Dre Skull Preview New Dancehall-Inspired Mixtape With Sizzling Vybz Kartel Collab: ‘I Think It Captures My Other Side’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey everyone, welcome to our podcast. Today, we're talking about the latest summer vibes in the music scene. Get ready to groove to the sweet sounds of dancehall, as Nigerian artist Mr Eazi teams up with superproducer Dre Skull on a brand new mixtape, 'Yard & Yanga'."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "This exciting project brings together the best of dancehall and Afrobeats, with none other than the King of Dancehall, Vybz Kartel, featuring on the lead single 'Lambo'. We spoke to Dre Skull about the collaboration, and he shared how it all came together."
[Clip of Dre Skull's quote plays]
Dre Skull: "Eazi and I have been working on music together for years, and we became good friends. When we go to the studio, we inevitably end up making music that weaves together elements of dancehall and Afrobeats, and those sessions became the starting point for this project."
Host: "Mr Eazi credits Nigerian dancehall-inspired konto artists like Baba Fryo and Kimi Ranky for introducing him to the genre. He loves the raw energy of dancehall and says it captures his other side. And with 'Lambo', he's brought that energy to life with Vybz Kartel."
[Clip of "Lambo" plays]
Host: "Dre Skull describes 'Lambo' as a summer-ready bashment banger with a hypnotic quality, thanks to its heavy low end and catchy hook. The song is just the beginning, as 'Yard & Yanga' is set to drop later this year via Mixpak Records and emPawa Africa."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, everyone. Make sure to check out 'Lambo' and get ready for the full 'Yard & Yanga' mixtape coming soon. We'll have more updates on the latest music trends, so stay tuned!"
